overview_description.description: Finley simplifies debt capital raise and management. Finley's software helps growing companies automate due diligence, ensure compliance, and streamline ongoing reporting with their capital providers. Customers like Ramp rely on Finley to manage hundreds of millions in debt capital from capital providers. The Finley team brings experience from Goldman Sachs, Nova Credit, and Palantir Technologies, and is backed by Y Combinator and Bain Capital Ventures.

about_short_description.short_description: Finley helps companies streamline debt capital raise and management.

product.name: Debt Capital Management Software
product.description: Software that automates, tracks, and manages debt capital operations including funding, verification, and analysis for borrowers, issuers, credit funds, and banks.

product.name: Monthly Servicer Reporting Capabilities
product.description: A module that streamlines the generation, tracking, and collaboration of Monthly Servicer Reports by aggregating data from multiple sources and managing report versions.

product.name: Activity Feature
product.description: A centralized log that tracks every deal-related action, comment, and stakeholder interaction to improve visibility and coordination across debt capital workflows.

product.name: Task Center
product.description: A centralized dashboard for tracking, managing, and executing outstanding tasks related to debt capital portfolios, including task assignment and deadline management.

product.name: Receivable Repurchasing Management
product.description: A tool that simplifies the correction and repurchasing of receivables across credit facilities through streamlined workflows and bulk updates.
